title: Viral metagenomics using SMART-9n amplification and nanopore sequencing
author: Ingra Claro Morales
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7w5hpg6
materials: Recover filtrate into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube
Start the following program on a thermocycler: 42 °C for 01:30:00 70 °C for 00:10:00

steps.title: Initial Sample Concentration
steps.instruction: Concentrate the sample using a centrifugal filter.

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 500 µL sample directly onto a Ultrafree-MC Centrifugal Filter column.
Spin at 5000 x g for 00:01:00.
Remove basket and discard.
Close lid and place on ice.

steps.title: Viral RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract viral RNA from the sample.

substeps.instruction: In a 2 mL Eppendorf tube, combine 200 µL sample and 200 µL DNA/RNA Shield (2x concentrate); mix well by pipetting.
Add 800 µL Viral RNA Buffer and mix well by pipetting.
Load 600 µL onto a column in a collection tube and spin at 10000 x g for 00:00:15; discard flow through and place in a new collection tube.
Add 500 µL Viral wash buffer and spin at 10000 x g for 00:00:15; discard flow through.
Add 500 µL 100% ethanol and spin at 10000 x g for 00:01:00; discard flow through and place in a clean 1.5 mL tube.
Add 15 µL of DNA/RNA-Free Water and incubate at RT for 00:03:00.
Spin at 10000 x g for 00:00:15.

steps.title: DNase Treatment of RNA
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating DNA from the extracted RNA.

substeps.instruction: Set heat block to 37 °C.
Prepare the reaction: 44 µL RNA, 5 µL 10X TURBO DNase Buffer, and 1 µL TURBO DNase (Total 50 µL).
Incubate at 37 °C for 00:30:00.

steps.title: RNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the DNase-treated RNA using a Zymo-Spin column.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL RNA Binding Buffer to the reaction, mix by vortexing for 00:00:05, and spin down.
Add 150 µL 100% ethanol, mix by vortexing for 00:00:15, and spin down.
Transfer 300 µL to a Zymo-Spin IC column in a 2 mL collection tube and spin at 6000 x g for 00:00:15; discard flow through.
Add 400 µL RNA Prep Buffer and spin at 6000 x g for 00:00:15; discard flow through.
Add 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer and spin at 6000 x g for 00:00:15; discard flow through and place in a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 10 µL DNase/RNase Free Water and incubate at RT for 00:01:00.
Spin at 6000 x g for 00:00:15.
Label as ‘Viral RNA’ and place on ice.

steps.title: Viral DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract viral DNA from the sample.

substeps.instruction: Set heat block to 55 °C.
In a 2 mL Eppendorf tube, combine 200 µL sample, 200 µL DNA/RNA Shield (2X concentrate), and 20 µL Proteinase K; mix well by pipetting.
Incubate at 55 °C for 00:30:00.
Set heat block to 60 °C.
Add 1.200 mL binding buffer and mix well.
Load 800 µL onto a Zymo-Spin IIC-Z column in a collection tube and spin at 8000 x g for 00:00:15; discard flow-through and reload as many times as required.
Transfer to a new collection tube, add 400 µL DNA Wash Buffer 1, and spin at 8000 x g for 00:00:15; discard flow-through.
Add 700 µL DNA Wash Buffer 2 and spin at 8000 x g for 00:00:15.
Add 200 µL DNA Wash Buffer 2 and spin at 8000 x g for 00:01:00.
Transfer to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add 50 µL DNA/RNA Free Water preheated to 60 °C to the column, and incubate at RT for 00:01:00.
Spin at 8000 x g for 00:01:00.

steps.title: RNA Annealing
steps.instruction: Anneal the template RNA with primers.

substeps.instruction: Combine the following in a 0.2ml 8-strip tube: 1 µL RLB RT 9N (2 uM), 1 µL dNTPs (10 mM ea.), and 10 µL Template RNA (Total 12 µL).
Mix and spin down.
Incubate at 65 °C for 00:05:00, then snap cool on ice.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the annealed RNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare master mix: 4 µL SSIV buffer (5x), 1 µL DTT (100 mM), 1 µL RNase OUT, 1 µL SS IV RTase (200 U/ul), and 1 µL RLB TSO (2 uM) (Total 20 µL).
Add 8 µL of this master mix to the 12 µL annealed RNA.

steps.title: cDNA Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA using a thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Set up the reaction in a new 0.2ml 8-strip tube: 25 µL LongAmp Taq 2X master mix, 0.5 µL RLB (01-12), 19.5 µL NFW, and 5 µL cDNA (Total 50 µL).

Run the following program: Heat Activation (95 °C, 00:00:45, 1 cycle); Denaturation (95 °C, 00:00:15, 26 cycles); Annealing (56 °C, 00:00:15, 26 cycles); Extension (65 °C, 00:05:00, 26 cycles); Final extension (65 °C, 00:10:00, 1 cycle); Hold (4 °C, Indefinite).

steps.title: Product Cleanup and Quantification
steps.instruction: Clean and quantify the PCR products.

substeps.instruction: Clean up products with 1x Ampure XP and elute in 30 ul EB.
Quantify the PCR products using the Quantus Fluorometer with the ONE dsDNA assay.

steps.title: Library Preparation and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Pool products and load onto the nanopore flowcell.

substeps.instruction: Pool all barcoded products to a total of 200 Femtomolar (fM) in 10 µL of 10 millimolar (mM) Tris-HCl pH 8.0 with 50 millimolar (mM) NaCl.
Add 1 µL RAP adapter, mix by pipetting, and incubate at RT for 00:05:00.
Prime the flowcell and load the sequencing library onto the flowcell.
